toni: Flagging ClearSight invoice question. They reported a $9,450 dedicated overage for 2026-06 that they say came from a maintenance-triggered failover + transient autoscale. Can finance + SRE take a look? @arjun @cecilia

arjun: Send invoice snippet and asserted window. I'll pull the usage lines and check tagging.

toni: From their upload:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0628
Reserved commit: $8,000
Burst/overage: $9,450
Period: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30
Claimed incident: 2026-06-18 03:10-04:45 UTC failover
```

cecilia: ops-bot shows INCIDENT-2026-457: scheduled-maintenance caused regional failover for pool clearsight-prod. Start 2026-06-18T03:07Z end 2026-06-18T04:50Z. Impact: autoscale + ephemeral egress.

ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-457 recorded. Affected: dedicated-clearsight-prod. Duration ~1h43m.

arjun: My metering pull: compute burst $6,120; cross-region egress $1,430; storage/rehydration and misc $680 => total $8,230. There's a $1,220 delta vs invoice; possible billing window misalignment or tagging differences.

toni: Customer wants full waive, says this broke an investor demo.

cecilia: Contract cues: we bill actual usage. For planned maint we provide notice; credits are discretionary. We do offer goodwill in similar cases. Propose: waive egress fees + 40% of compute burst. That would be ~egress $1,430 + compute credit $2,448 = $3,878. Offer a one-month Dedicated Insights retention as goodwill.

arjun: I'll prepare a credit memo: "Goodwill credit - maintenance linked failover: compute credit $2,448; egress waived $1,430; total credit $3,878. Reference CM-2026-1301."

nate: Approving CM-2026-1301. Please tag as "Goodwill - ops outage" and document the decision in the invoice notes.

arjun: CM-2026-1301 created and applied to INV-2026-0628. Journal entry JE-2026-1077 recorded. Updated invoice pushed to billing portal.

tonI: I'll send a customer-facing reply: apology, brief cause statement, credit applied, link to non-sensitive postmortem, and offer single-month retention.

cecilia: Legal reviewed - OK. No long-term precedent risk.

ops-bot: ACTIONS: 1) Credit applied - arjun. 2) Customer comms - toni. 3) SRE postmortem to eng-sre - cecilia.

toni: Customer confirmed receipt and accepted the credit. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
